items.docs: Emit a single analytics event — the most common write endpoint. Requires an ingest-scope key (pk_* browser, origin-checked; or sk_* server). The server enriches every event with source/medium classification, geo, device, and a hashed IP before insert.

info.name: Emit up to 1000 events in one call

items.docs: Send up to 1000 events in a single request. All-or-nothing at the request level — if validation fails on any event, none are written. Used by the browser SDK for buffered flushes. Requires an ingest-scope key (pk_* or sk_*).
